name: Nike Air Max 90 'Triple White'
story_html: The Air Max 90 'Triple White' launched in January 2020, marking the classic silhouette’s 30th anniversary. Featuring a recrafted build inspired by the original 1990 release, the sneaker is dressed in an all-white finish that allows its clean lines to stand out. Details include a mesh upper with stitched leather overlays, TPU eyelets and an Air-infused midsole reinforced by a waffle-tread rubber outsole.
